newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHORT RATES UP, BONDS FLAT, ECU/DRS RANGES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHORT RATES UP, BONDS FLAT, ECU/DRS RANGES.

text.p: Greek short-term depos opened firmer but for a softer overnight and short-dated forex forwards were also up, ecu/drachma was rangebound and bonds were stable unaffected by Tuesday's auction of fixed coupon bonds, dealers said.

"Short-term interbank rates are up except for the overnight which is trading lower," said a dealer at a private bank. "Funding for bonds and uncertainty over the amount that the central bank will absorb today account for the rise."
Bank of Greece offered to drain 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in its regular depo tender.
"The market might need a cash injection tomorrow if the central bank drains more than 150 billion drachmas of 14-day funds today," said a senior dealer at a private bank.
Bond dealers called Tuesday's auction of three-, five-, seven-year and 10-year bonds a success.

"The outcome of the auction was better than expected and the ministry should be pleased given the international environment and the firmer interbank rates," said another senior dealer at a private bank.
Dealers said bonds and FRNs were little changed in the secondary market.
"Investors should be prepared to carry the bonds they got at yesterday's auction because secondary bond market prices are not that attractive right now," said a bond dealer.
Greece auctioned 100 billion drachmas of 10-year, 8.80 percent fixed coupon bonds. It was Greece's first ever issue of 10-year drachma-denominated bonds.
It also re-opened bids for three-year, 9.8 percent bonds, five-year, 9.2 percent bonds and seven-year, 8.9 percent bonds. Fifty billion drachmas for each maturity are auctioned.
The cut-off prices were set at 100.1, 99.25, 98.77, 98.61 for the three-, five-, seven- and 10-year fixed coupon bonds respectively, the central bank said.
The mark was quoted at 158.23/33 from Tuesday's 158.000 fix, the dollar at 272.89/99 drachmas from 274.250 and the ecu at 309.29/48 from 309.090 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is rangebound between 309 and 309.40," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "309 seems to be a strong support level for the ecu."
